description: This file contains the implementation of AdoNetQueueAdapter class, which acts as a storage adapter for ADO.NET providers to handle streaming queues within Orleans. It includes methods for creating receivers and queuing message batches, utilizing various options, queries, and mappings specific to the ADO.NET streaming extension.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapter
classes.description: A storage adapter for streaming queues using ADO.NET providers within Orleans, responsible for queuing messages and creating receivers.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a receiver for a specified queue, utilizing internal mapper and factory.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Queues a batch of messages asynchronously to a stream, handling serialization and exceptions.
